Hi Tom / Sofia 

Thanks again for your time today  great discussion. Quick recap+actions so we keep momentum with the buying committee. I summarized what we heard from each stakeholder and next steps below.

Key stakeholders (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Tom Riley (CFO)  will own budget + final sign-off
- Security/Compliance: Sofia Martinez  will own SOC2, data residency, audit requests
- Procurement: procurement@paymentsinc.com  handles PO and contract flow
- Day-to-day users / engineering: (tbd)  we can map after discovery

Demo highlights (2 min)
- Latency & throughput profile for your 1k QPS batch use case; typical 99th p90 within SLA with Dedicated capacity
- Prefix/KV caching and cost estimates that reduce per-token cost for repeated queries
- Integrations: SSO (SAML/OIDC), KMS key control, and VPC peering for Private deployment

Open questions / asks
1) Confirm the procurement timeline and required docs for vendor setup (PO vs. contract).
2) Sofia  can you confirm the security artifacts you need (SOC2 Type II, penetration test report, data retention policy)? We can share our SOC2 summary and retention doc.
3) Tom  high-level pricing band OK for planning? I attached a one-pager and an initial evaluation plan to help scope a 2-week POC.

Proposed next steps
- Ill share SOC2 summary + data retention doc (attached).
- Schedule a 3045m procurement + legal sync (include procurement@paymentsinc.com and your legal counsel)  propose Mon/Tue next week.
- Internal: Ive looped Neha (AE) and Rishi (CS) to scope the POC and follow up on technical questions.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, evaluation-plan.xlsx

Thanks  Ill follow up with calendar invites once I have timing preferences.

Best,
